mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session (user_id, title, message_count, last_message_at, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{messageCount}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET title = #{title}, message_count = #{messageCount}, last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
